units.title: am / is / are
units.tip: I için am, he/she/it için is, you/we/they için are kullanılır. Olumsuz için not ekleriz: She is not tired.

items.en: I am a student.
She is very tired.
I ___ from Turkey.
We are not at home.
They ___ my neighbours.
Are you ready?
___ he a doctor?
The cat is in the garden.
My brothers ___ not at school.
He is not my friend.
It ___ not cold today.
Is your mother at home?

units.title: was / were
units.tip: I, he, she, it için was; you, we, they için were kullanılır. Örnek: I was at home. They were happy.

items.en: I was at home yesterday.
They were on holiday last week.
My parents ___ at work this morning.
items.tr: Annem ve babam bu sabah işteydi.

items.en: The weather was cold yesterday.
I ___ not at the party.
We were not tired.
___ they happy with the food?
Were you at school yesterday?
It ___ a great day.
She was not ill yesterday.
The shops ___ closed on Sunday.
Was the film good?

units.title: Şimdiki zaman: I am going
units.tip: Şu anda olan şeyler için am/is/are + fiil-ing kullanılır. Örnek: She is reading a book.

items.en: I am drinking water.
She is watching television now.
I ___ going to school now.
The children are playing in the garden.
He ___ sleeping at the moment.
We are not cooking dinner.
They are ___ football.
What are you reading?
She is not ___ a book.
My mother is working in the kitchen.
Are you ___ to music?
Is it raining?

units.title: Geniş zaman: I go, she goes
units.tip: Alışkanlıklar için geniş zaman kullanılır; he/she/it ile fiile -s eklenir. Olumsuz ve soru için do/does kullanılır: She does not go. Do you go?

items.en: I drink tea every day.
She goes to school by bus.
My sister ___ in a bank.
We do not eat meat.
They ___ like fish.
My father does not like coffee.
___ she play tennis?
Do you speak English?
He does not ___ milk.
Does Ali live in London?
We ___ breakfast at eight.
My cat drinks milk.

units.title: There is / there are
units.tip: Bir şeyin var olduğunu söylemek için tekilde there is, çoğulda there are kullanılır. Örnek: There is a book. There are two books.

items.en: There is a table in the room.
There are two children in the park.
There ___ a cat on the sofa.
There is not a book in my bag.
There ___ three bedrooms in our house.
Is there a museum in the city?
___ there a bank near here?
items.tr: Buraya yakın bir banka var mı?

items.en: There are not any apples on the table.
There are not ___ chairs in the room.
How many students are there?
There ___ not any water in the bottle.
There is some milk at home.

units.title: Soru kelimeleri: what, where, who
units.tip: What (ne), where (nerede), who (kim), when (ne zaman), why (neden), how (nasıl) soru başında gelir. Örnek: Where do you live?

items.en: What is your name?
Where is the school?
___ is your teacher?
Who is that man?
___ is your birthday? It is in May.
When is your birthday?
___ are you from? I am from Izmir.
Why are you sad?
___ do you like this song? Because it is nice.
items.tr: Bu şarkıyı neden seviyorsun? Çünkü güzel.

items.en: How are you today?
___ old are you?
Where do you live?

units.title: can / can't
units.tip: Yapabilmek için can + fiil kullanılır; fiile -s eklenmez. Olumsuzu cannot. Örnek: She can swim. I cannot swim.

items.en: I can swim.
She can play the guitar.
My brother ___ run very fast.
We cannot come today.
I cannot ___ the answer.
Can you drive a car?
___ you help me, please?
Birds can fly.
She can ___ three languages.
My father cannot speak English.
Fish ___ walk.
Can I park here?

units.title: have / has
units.tip: I, you, we, they ile have; he, she, it ile has kullanılır. Olumsuz ve soru için do/does gerekir: She does not have a car. Do you have a pen?

items.en: I have a dog.
She has two sisters.
My mother ___ a new phone.
We do not have a car.
I ___ two brothers.
Ali does not have a computer.
Do you ___ any money?
Do you have a pen?
She does not ___ a car.
Does he have a bike?
___ they have a garden?
They have a big house.

units.title: Geçmiş zaman: I went
units.tip: Geçmiş olayları anlatırken düzenli fiillere -ed eklenir (cook → cooked), düzensizlerin ise özel biçimi vardır (go → went). Soru ve olumsuzda did / did not + fiilin yalın hali kullanılır: I did not go.

items.en: We ate pizza last night.
I did not go to the shop yesterday.
She ___ a letter to her friend yesterday.

items.tr: Ali geçen hafta yeni bir telefon aldı.
items.en: Ali bought a new phone last week.
___ you like the film?

items.tr: Dün gece bir film izledin mi?
items.en: Did you watch a film last night?
My mother cooked dinner this evening.
We ___ tired after the long walk.
They did not come to our house yesterday.
He did not ___ the bus.
I woke up early this morning.
They ___ to the beach last summer.

units.title: going to
units.tip: Plan ve tahminler için am / is / are + going to + fiil kullanılır: I am going to study tonight. Olumsuzda not eklenir: She is not going to come.

items.en: I am going to visit my friend tomorrow.
It is going to rain.
Look at those clouds! It ___ going to rain.
What are you going to do this weekend?
I ___ going to learn English this year.
We are not going to cook tonight.
Ahmet is going to be a doctor.
They are going to ___ a party on Saturday.
Are you going to buy a new car?
She ___ not going to come to the meeting.
I am going to sleep early tonight.
Are you ___ to wait for me?

units.title: will / won't
units.tip: Anlık kararlar, söz ve tahminler için will + fiil kullanılır: I will help you. Olumsuzu will not (kısaca won't) şeklindedir; fiil her zaman yalın haldedir.

items.en: I will call you tomorrow.
We will help you with your homework.
I ___ open the window because it is hot in here.
It will be sunny tomorrow.
It is cold. I think it ___ snow tonight.
items.tr: Hava soğuk. Bence bu gece kar yağacak.

items.en: I will not answer this question.
I think you will pass the exam.
She will ___ you the answer later.
Will you come to school tomorrow?
We ___ not forget your birthday.
He will not be late.
___ you help me carry this bag?
items.tr: Bu çantayı taşımama yardım eder misin?

units.title: Karşılaştırma: bigger, the biggest
units.tip: Kısa sıfatlara -er / -est eklenir (tall → taller → the tallest), uzun sıfatlarda more / the most kullanılır (more interesting). Karşılaştırmada than gelir: bigger than.

items.en: This bag is heavier than that one.
He is the tallest boy in the class.
My brother is ___ than me.
Ankara is smaller than Istanbul.
This is the ___ day of the year.
This film is more interesting than the other one.
She is my best friend.
English is ___ than maths for me.
items.tr: Bana göre İngilizce matematikten daha kolay.

items.en: It is hotter today than yesterday.
Today is ___ than yesterday.
This is the most expensive watch in the world.
She is the ___ person I know.

units.title: must / have to / should
units.tip: Zorunluluk için must veya have to, tavsiye için should kullanılır: You should rest. Must not yasak, do not have to ise zorunlu olmama demektir. Geçmişte had to kullanılır.

items.en: I have to get up early tomorrow.
You should drink more water.
You ___ stop at a red light.
You must not smoke here.
She ___ to work on Sundays.
I had to work last night.
We do not have to go to school tomorrow.
You look tired. You ___ rest.
You should see a doctor.
I ___ not have to pay for the bus.
items.tr: Otobüs için ödeme yapmak zorunda değilim.

items.en: Ali has to wear a uniform.
Students ___ not use phones in the exam.

units.title: Edatlar: in, on, at
units.tip: Saat ve belirli noktalar için at (at nine), günler için on (on Monday), ay, yıl ve mevsimler için in (in May). Yer için: at bir nokta (at school), in bir alan veya şehir (in Istanbul), on bir yüzey (on the table).

items.en: The lesson starts at nine.
My birthday is in May.
We have lunch ___ noon.
I will see the doctor on Monday.
She was born ___ 1998.
My keys are on the table.
My brother is at school now.
The film starts ___ Friday evening.
We live in Istanbul.
There is a picture ___ the wall.
I usually go to bed late at night.
I met him ___ the bus stop.

units.title: some / any / much / many
units.tip: Olumlu cümlede some, olumsuz ve soruda any kullanılır. Sayılabilenlerle many (many books), sayılamayanlarla much (much water) gelir.

items.en: I have some water in my bag.
There is not any bread at home.
Do you have ___ brothers or sisters?
How many brothers do you have?
There is too ___ traffic in the morning.
How much milk do you want?
I have a lot of work today.
We need ___ eggs for the cake.
items.tr: Pasta için biraz yumurtaya ihtiyacımız var.

items.en: Would you like some tea?
How ___ people came to the party?
There are not many parks in the city.
I do not have ___ money today.

units.title: Present perfect: I have been
units.tip: have/has + üçüncü fiil (V3) ile geçmişte başlayan ya da şimdiyle bağlantılı olayları anlatırız. Örnek: I have already eaten (Çoktan yedim).

items.en: I have never been to Paris.
She has already finished her work.
My sister ___ never eaten sushi.
We have not eaten yet.
I ___ lived in this city since 2015.
I have just received a message.
Have you finished your homework ___?
Have you ever been to England?
They have ___ gone to the airport.
Tom has lived here for three years.
We have ___ that film twice.
My brother has not opened the door.

units.title: Geçmişte süren: I was going
units.tip: was/were + fiil-ing, geçmişte belli bir anda devam eden eylemi anlatır. when kısa olayı, while uzun süren eylemi bağlar. Örnek: I was reading when you called.

items.en: The phone rang while I was showering.
alt: While I was showering the phone rang.

items.en: They were playing football last night.
I ___ TV when the lights went out.
Were you sleeping when I called?
alt: When I called were you sleeping?

items.en: What ___ you doing at nine last night?
My mother was cooking dinner.
He broke his arm while he ___ football.
We were walking while it was raining.
alt: While it was raining we were walking.

items.en: The children ___ in the garden when it started to rain.
She was not looking at me.
It ___ snowing when we left home.
The teacher came in while we were working.
alt: While we were working the teacher came in.

units.title: If cümleleri
units.tip: Gerçek ihtimal: if + şimdiki zaman, will + fiil. Hayali durum: if + geçmiş zaman, would + fiil. Örnek: If it rains, I will stay home.

items.en: I will stay home if it rains.
alt: If it rains I will stay home.

items.en: I would travel if I had money.
alt: If I had money I would travel.

items.en: If I ___ rich I would buy a big house.
items.tr: Zengin olsaydım büyük bir ev alırdım.

items.en: You will catch the train if you get up early.
alt: If you get up early you will catch the train.

items.en: If you ___ me I will help you.

items.tr: Ben senin yerinde olsam ona söylerdim.
items.en: I would tell him if I were you.
alt: If I were you I would tell him.

items.en: If she studied more she ___ better marks.
items.tr: Daha çok çalışsaydı daha iyi notlar alırdı.

items.en: You will not pass if you do not study.
alt: If you do not study you will not pass.

items.en: We will be late if we ___ now.
She would be very happy if she won.
alt: If she won she would be very happy.

items.en: What would you do if you ___ a million pounds?
items.tr: Bir milyon sterlin kazansaydın ne yapardın?

items.en: We will have a picnic if it is sunny.
alt: If it is sunny we will have a picnic.

units.title: Edilgen: it was made
units.tip: Edilgen yapı be + üçüncü fiil (V3) ile kurulur. Şimdiki zamanda is/are, geçmişte was/were kullanılır. Örnek: The cake was eaten (Pasta yenildi).

items.en: This car is made in Germany.
The bridge was built last year.
Many cars ___ in Japan every year.
items.tr: Japonya'da her yıl birçok araba üretilir.

items.en: These rooms are cleaned every day.
The window ___ by a ball yesterday.
items.tr: Pencere dün bir top tarafından kırıldı.

items.en: The letter was sent yesterday.
Rice is ___ in many countries.
English is spoken in many countries.
The dinner ___ by my father last night.
items.tr: Akşam yemeği dün gece babam tarafından pişirildi.

items.en: The windows were broken by the children.
My phone ___ stolen last week.

items.tr: Bu film dün gece izlendi mi?
items.en: Was this film watched last night?

units.title: who / which / that / where
units.tip: who kişiler, which/that şeyler, where yerler, whose ise aitlik için kullanılır. Örnek: The man who lives here is a doctor.

items.en: This is the man who helped me.
The book that I bought yesterday is interesting.
The woman ___ lives next door is a nurse.
The city where I was born is very big.
That is the restaurant ___ we had dinner.

items.tr: Bir kafe işleten bir kadın tanıyorum.
items.en: I know a woman who owns a cafe.
I lost the umbrella ___ my mother gave me.

items.tr: Bu, onun geçen yıl yazdığı şarkı.
items.en: This is the song which she wrote last year.
He is the boy ___ bike was stolen.

items.tr: Kız kardeşi doktor olan bir arkadaşım var.
items.en: I have a friend whose sister is a doctor.
This is the machine ___ makes our coffee.
The park where the children play is closed.

units.title: Dolaylı anlatım: she said that
units.tip: Dolaylı anlatımda zaman genellikle bir adım geriye gider: am/is → was, will → would. Örnek: She said that she was tired.

items.en: Ali said that he was tired.
My mother said that she would come late.
He said that he ___ a new car.
items.tr: Yeni bir araba almış olduğunu söyledi.

items.en: She asked me where I lived.
She asked me what time the film ___.

items.tr: Öğretmen bize ödevi bitirip bitirmediğimizi sordu.
items.en: The teacher asked us if we had finished the homework.
She said that she ___ seen him before.
items.tr: Onu daha önce görmüş olduğunu söyledi.

items.en: Tom told me that he was ill.
I asked him ___ he wanted some tea.
Sarah wanted to know where I had gone.
He told ___ that the shop was closed.
They said that they would call me later.

units.title: I wish / should have
units.tip: Şimdiki pişmanlık için I wish + geçmiş zaman, geçmişteki pişmanlık için I wish + had + V3 veya should have + V3 kullanılır. Örnek: I should have studied.

items.en: I wish I had more money.
I wish you were here.
I wish I ___ taller.
I wish I had studied harder.
I should ___ brought an umbrella.
You should have gone to the doctor.
She wishes she ___ the exam last week.
I wish I could run faster.
He wishes he ___ more free time now.
items.tr: Keşke şimdi daha fazla boş zamanı olsa.

items.en: I should not have said that.
We should not ___ so late last night.
items.tr: Dün gece o kadar geç kalmamalıydık.

items.en: I wish we had left earlier.
